Skyrim:Simon Rodayne's Heart - UESP Wiki - The Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages
s: Simon Rodayne's Heart is the purified heart of Simon Rodayne. You will initially find it at Karthspire Camp as a Corrupted Human Heart during the quest Crypt of the Heart, but you will have the option to transform it into this item by activating the Shrine of Mara at his grave.

t: Skyrim:Simon Rodayne - UESP Wiki - The Unofficial Elder Scrolls Pages
s: Simon Rodayne is a ghost Breton spellsword, who in life was a member of the Order of the Crypt, before he fell in love with (or was tricked by) a witch of the Beldama Wyrd named Daenella and consequently killed. He is said to haunt the banks of the Karth River at night, below his hilltop grave.
